# Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2024 Summary

## Overview
The Liberal Democrats' 2024 manifesto, titled "For a Fair Deal," presents a comprehensive vision for transforming British politics and addressing what they describe as years of Conservative neglect across healthcare, the economy, environment, and public services.

## Key Themes

### Economy
The party pledges responsible fiscal management while investing in green infrastructure and renewable energy. Key proposals include replacing business rates with a Commercial Landowner Levy, reforming capital gains tax, increasing the Digital Services Tax on tech giants, and creating Lifelong Skills Grants of £5,000 for adult education. They emphasise fixing the UK's relationship with Europe to remove trade barriers.

### Healthcare
The NHS features prominently, with promises to guarantee GP appointments within seven days (24 hours for urgent cases) by recruiting 8,000 additional GPs. They propose mental health professionals in every school, guaranteed NHS dentist access for emergency care, and a 62-day cancer treatment guarantee. Social care reform includes introducing free personal care and creating a Royal College of Care Workers with improved wages.

### Environment
The manifesto commits to net zero by 2045, with 90% renewable electricity by 2030. Central to their environmental agenda is tackling the sewage scandal by transforming water companies into public benefit companies and banning executive bonuses until pollution ends. They propose planting 60 million trees annually and passing a Clean Air Act.

### Housing
Plans include building 380,000 homes annually, including 150,000 social homes, through ten new garden cities. They would ban no-fault evictions, abolish residential leaseholds, and end rough sleeping within the Parliament.

### Political Reform
The party advocates proportional representation via Single Transferable Vote for MPs and councillors, votes at 16, scrapping voter ID requirements, and capping political donations. They propose enshrining the Ministerial Code in law and reforming the House of Lords.

### International Affairs
The manifesto emphasises rebuilding European relationships through a four-stage roadmap ultimately aiming for Single Market membership. They support Ukraine, advocate for a bilateral ceasefire in Gaza with recognition of Palestinian statehood, and pledge to restore international development spending to 0.7% of national income.

### Defence
Commitments include reversing Army cuts, increasing defence spending toward 2.5% of GDP, maintaining the nuclear deterrent, and strengthening NATO cooperation while improving conditions for service personnel.
